metric_definitions.scope: Only public training histories and aligned training targets are used. Targets may have influenced fitting. No additional predictor is fitted.
metric_definitions.identity: Within this category invocation, identity is (training user ID, zero-based target endpoint). All matching endpoints are searched; ambiguous encoded-prefix/target matches are excluded. The category is supplied by the host's per-category invocation.
metric_definitions.sampling: At most ten loader batches and 128 unique events. Target-frequency quintiles keep equal frequencies together. Length cells are 1-5, 6-15, 16-31, 32+. Even allocation over nonempty cells, capacity capped, followed by fixed cell-order redistribution; seed 42 sampling without replacement. Summaries describe selected events with equal event weights, not the natural training population.
metric_definitions.repeat_capable: All IDs 1..itemnum are eligible, including previously consumed items. Padding is excluded. Repeat means the target occurs in complete strictly pre-target training history.
metric_definitions.unseen_target: Repeat-target events are excluded. For first-time targets, every item in complete strictly pre-target training history is excluded from candidates.
metric_definitions.rank_bounds: Excluding the target, g counts computed scores strictly greater than the target and t counts exactly equal scores. One-based bounds are [1+g,1+g+t]. HR@10 lower uses the upper rank; HR@10 upper uses the lower rank. These are training diagnostic tie bounds, not the host tie policy.
metric_definitions.rank_id_ascending: Diagnostic total order: descending computed score, then ascending integer item ID. Exact equality is used, without tolerance.
metric_definitions.tenth_competitor_margin: Target score minus the tenth highest eligible alternative score. Competitors use descending score then ascending ID. Missing with fewer than ten alternatives. Unobserved items are not confirmed negatives.
metric_definitions.supplied_negative: The first cached negative for each uniquely identified event is retained; repeated draws are not averaged. It must be a valid catalog ID distinct from the target. original_supplied_negative_events records selected events with finite features and target scores before catalog rank exclusions. Missing margins indicate invalid or nonfinite negatives. Margins use target and negative scores extracted from the same first-pass catalog calls, with subtraction in Python floating point. Protocol summaries condition on valid catalog results; paired summaries additionally require an eligible finite supplied negative. These populations are distinct from the original cached-row diagnostic population.
metric_definitions.numerics: FP32 features and scoring, autocast disabled, TF32 disabled, deterministic algorithms requested. Each target is extracted from its actual catalog chunk before masking. A second pass repeats identical feature/chunk shapes and calls. Ranks are exact for these computed scores and eligibility only; shape invariance is not claimed.
metric_definitions.validation: Streaming counts, stable competitor identities and scores are checked against materialized identical second-pass chunk scores for up to two selected events. Synthetic checks cover ties, exclusions, repeats and fewer than ten alternatives. This does not certify another GEMM shape.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: No confidence intervals are computed. Results condition on this selected stratified sample, checkpoint and numerical configuration; training, search and event-sampling uncertainty are not estimated.
metric_definitions.counts: Counts distinguish cached rows, unique eligible event identities, sampling and numerical exclusions. Missing measurements are unknown, not zero or evidence of health.
